title: Integrity-bound production context
description: Context version 2 removes legacy spending metadata from creative identity. Version 1 remains schema-readable for historical reconciliation, without rewriting stored hashes or approval records. New identities use version 2. effective_sha256 is SHA256 of production_context.context_fingerprint_payload serialized as sorted-key compact JSON, UTF-8, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false. Unit payload fields are context_version, kind, unit_id, format, unit_brief_sha256, ordered scene_ids, profile, effective_settings and shared_inputs. unit_brief_sha256 hashes canonical JSON containing parsed metadata without legacy budgets and the universal-newline-decoded prose body. YAML formatting and comments are not creative identity; non-budget incidental metadata remains bound. Production payload omits unit IDs, briefs and membership. context_project_sha256 hashes the production payload for request v3 and decision v2. Legacy request v1/v2 and decision v1 retain raw project hashes. Historical v1 contexts require explicit re-preparation for new submissions, never silent rehashing. Typed scope never substitutes for real upstream file hashes or mode-authorized review.
$comment: Version 2 field projection: profile is the complete selected load_profile record. effective_settings excludes the exact operational top-level paths listed in production_context.OPERATIONAL_PATHS. shared_inputs selects production, market, episode, delivery, creative, creative_intent, story, directorial_axes, locked, locks, approval_mode, review_mode, approval, authorization and rights plus body_sha256. At the shared_inputs, effective_settings and unit_brief metadata roots, budget, unit_budget and spending_cap are excluded completely, regardless of value. Direct locked keys whose first dotted segment is one of those three fields are excluded too; empty locked objects are omitted from fingerprints, while authority validation still rejects explicit erasure of creative locks. Unit metadata uses distinct mapping, sequence and timestamp encodings before canonical serialization. Source metadata is never modified. All other nested fields remain bound, including story.budget, story.secret and story.path. There is no recursive budget-name exclusion. Missing estimates, legacy caps and currency differences never enforce spending policy. Unrelated manifest units, deliverables, candidate paths and absolute resolver paths are not payload fields; credentials belong in runtime configuration.
